transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… it’s the eating at night. I’ll start picking at leftovers, and even when I’m telling myself, “that’s enough, Alejandro,” I just keep going back for more. It feels like I’m not really stopping myself.
Do you find yourself eating a large amount of food in one sitting, even when you’re not hungry, and feel like you can’t stop once you start?
Yeah… mostly at night. I’ll start with leftovers, and I’m not really hungry, but once I start it’s like I know I should stop and… I just keep reaching for more anyway.
When you’re eating during these nighttime episodes, do you find yourself eating much more quickly than you normally would?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to the speed, I guess… it’s more just that I keep going.
During these nighttime eating episodes, do you feel like you’re not in control of your eating, like you can’t stop even if you want to?
Yeah… that’s pretty much it. I’ll tell myself, “that’s enough, Alejandro,” but then my hand just keeps going back to the leftovers anyway. It doesn’t feel like I’m really in control of it.
During these nighttime eating episodes, do you find yourself eating until you're uncomfortably full?
Sometimes, yeah. I don’t usually get sick or anything, but I’ll eat enough that my belt feels tight… and I have to just sit in my workshop chair for a while till my stomach settles.
Does this nighttime eating cause you a lot of distress or interfere with your daily life in any way?
I mean… it bothers me, yeah. I still get my errands done and make my appointments, and I help around the house. But the next morning I feel kind of sluggish, and… not too proud of myself, I guess.
Can you tell me if these nighttime eating episodes usually happen within a short period of time, like over the course of a couple of hours?

Yeah… usually it’s not all night or anything. It’s more like after supper, when I’m putting food away, and then within a couple hours I’ve had several servings… maybe some pan dulce too. More than I’d take if everyone was sitting there watching.
After these nighttime eating episodes, do you often feel guilty or ashamed about how much you ate?
I don’t know… guilty, maybe a little. I mostly just feel kind of embarrassed with myself and don’t like thinking about it too much.
Do these nighttime eating episodes happen after you’ve already gone to bed and fallen asleep, like you wake up and then start eating?
I don’t think so… not usually. It’s more before I’m really in bed. I can’t say I’ve noticed waking up just to eat.
